recipes.name: The Easiest Mashed Potatoes (3 Ingredients)
ingredients: 2 lbs (906g) Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1” pieces
instructions: To a 6 - 8 quart stock pot, bring your potatoes to a boil in heavily salted water, around 15 - 20 minutes or until fork tender.
While the potatoes cook, to a small saucepan combine half and half and butter and cook over medium heat until the butter is completely melted and hot. Keep warm until potatoes are cooked.

Once the potatoes are done cooking, strain and drain thoroughly. The drier the potato, the more cream and butter it can absorb. While your potatoes are still hot, into your stock pot, press the potatoes through a potato ricer on the finest setting. You can also return the potatoes to the stock pot and mash them with a hand masher.
Whisk your melted butter and half and half into the mashed potatoes until fully combined. Taste for seasoning and add more salt if necessary. Serve and enjoy.
